description.value: Marcello Ristorante & Pizzeria is a long-standing neighbourhood favourite on Vancouver's Commercial Drive, serving traditional Southern Italian cuisine rooted in owner Marcello's upbringing in Palermo and professional training in Milan. The full menu spans woodfire pizza, house-made pasta, antipasti, and an extensive Italian cocktail list in a sit-down ristorante setting. The restaurant accommodates group events for up to 24 guests, making it a practical stop for cycling club dinners or post-ride celebrations.
